description:
Minseok is a boy pushed to his limits by hunger and a lack of affection. After meeting Jiho, he is drawn to Jiho’s gentle touch and impulsively throws himself into his arms. As Jiho gradually grows used to these gestures, he begins to open his heart to Minseok...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/shameless), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/shame_less), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056835), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9628447), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230352)
